# Siqi Liu

> Personal site of Siqi Liu, also known as Yosgi. Siqi Liu is a software engineer at Nextspace Ltd in Auckland with 9+ years of experience across product engineering, frontend architecture, full-stack systems, digital twins, industrial IoT, and AI platform work.

Use the English pages when a language-neutral answer is preferred. Chinese pages include both translations and original Chinese writing.
